description: This file contains implementation of NamedTensor utilities and methods for the ATen library in PyTorch, including tensor renaming, alignment, and related operations.

methods.name: Tensor & rename_(Tensor & self,std::optional<DimnameList> names)
methods.description: In-place renaming of a tensor with optional names.

methods.name: Tensor rename(const Tensor & self,std::optional<DimnameList> names)
methods.description: Returns a renamed copy of the tensor with specified names.

methods.name: Tensor refine_names(const Tensor & self,DimnameList names)
methods.description: Refines the tensor's existing names to a new specified set of names.

methods.name: Tensor align(const Tensor & tensor,DimnameList names,bool is_aligning_two_tensors)
methods.description: Aligns a tensor to specified dimensional names without changing data layout.

methods.name: Tensor align_as(const Tensor & tensor,const Tensor & other)
methods.description: Aligns a tensor to another tensor's names.

methods.name: std::vector<Tensor> align_tensors(TensorList tensors)
methods.description: Aligns a list of tensors to the longest tensor by default.

methods.name: std::vector<Tensor> align_tensors_to(TensorList tensors,DimnameList names)
methods.description: Aligns a list of tensors to a specified set of names.

methods.name: Tensor align_to(const Tensor & tensor,DimnameList names)
methods.description: Aligns a tensor to a list of names, expanding dimensions as needed.
